Fix annotation UX: margin notes, persistent selection, monitor details

- Replace hover tooltips with margin notes aligned to highlighted text
- Add pending-highlight to preserve text selection while popover is open
- Document correct positioning math (no scrollTop double-count)
- Add concrete Monitor tool instructions for annotation file watching
- Add workflow diagram to README

Fix prose: plain writing, add progress updates

Apply plain-writing rules to both skill files. Remove
metaphors (buckets, blind spots, go deep), fix inanimate
subjects doing actions (suggestions land, UI picks up,
dimensions drive), replace dashes with periods, expand
compressed sentences. Add progress update instructions
so the agent explains what it is doing at each step.

Split skill into build (SKILL.md) and run (review-loop.md)

SKILL.md covers phases 1-4: understand data, design visual encoding,
build the app, cluster and select samples. review-loop.md covers
phase 5: the ongoing interactive session with breadth/depth framing,
subagent scanning, re-review, and convergence.

Simplify re-review and clarify one subagent per mode

5e: remove overengineered tracking, just encourage re-reading
earlier records after new modes are discovered. 5c: clarify
one background subagent per failure mode, not per record.

New 5e section: track when records were reviewed, suggest revisiting
after criteria drift (2-3 new modes discovered). Already-reviewed
records with new agent suggestions are highest-priority re-review
candidates. Fixed duplicate principle numbers 6/7.

Use subagents to parallelize failure mode scanning

When new modes are discovered, spawn subagents per mode to scan
all records in parallel. Results merge into suggestions. Runs in
background while the human keeps reviewing.

Add agent suggestion workflow and iteration principles

When new failure modes are discovered, the agent scans all records
(including already-reviewed ones) for instances and surfaces them
as suggestions. Human accepts or dismisses. Adds principles about
criteria drift and multi-pass iteration.
